items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I went to 35th and State, that's when I met Red Ernest.

ctx.x: And although they had all these tough detectives....

That's right. That's where they had the toughest railroad detectives in the world. And I went right on through and didn't have, didn't was bothered once. And I went to 35th and State, that's when I met Red Ernest. His brother and I was in the navy together.
